description: Retrieval golden set for the knowledge base (kb_documents/kb_chunks). Answerable cases name the Guardian content id that answers them; those documents are pinned (kb_documents.pinned = true) so the 90-day prune never removes them. Two questions per pinned doc: one reusing the article's wording (lexical), one that doesn't (paraphrase). expectChunkContains phrases were verified against the stored chunks on 2026-10-25; several also occur in a second article on purpose (Rice's 82nd-minute goal, Russo, Vivell, Penders, Jackson) — near-duplicate distractors. Unanswerable cases expect nothing above the similarity floor. Run: EVAL_LIVE=1 npx vitest run src/ai/evals/retrieval.test.ts
